description_excerpt: Job Description Testing & Validation Activities • Support Testing Engineers in the preparation and execution of validation activities for automotive components and materials. • Prepare test samples, specimens, test setups, and measurement equipment before testing. • Perform different validation tests under the supervision of Testing Engineers, such as: • Samples preparation , wires harness preparation • Mechanical force and strength testing • Electrical testing and measurement • Sealing and leakage testing • Environmental and component-level validation testing • Monitor test execution,…
